The strict-selectors FAILURE direction is bound executably above.

The PLAN_SATISFIED / PLAN_PARTIAL / PLAN_NOT_SHIPPED status label is model-emitted report prose, composed by the agent from Step V6's instructions over live plan_satisfaction data — no script computes it, it is neither persisted nor parsed, and it surfaces as report text, not a process exit code the cli-exit oracle can assert. (Corrected 2026-08-20, lens-coverage-honesty plan §1.1: the prior reason described the underlying satisfaction DATA as browser-driven, which is true, but the gate claim being dispositioned is the STATUS LABEL a script never computes.)
